content: The pharmacophore is complete but QED fell to 0.739, and the reason is the leftover aniline NH2 at atom 19: it pushes donors to 3 and TPSA to 80. It is also redundant - the two N-H groups that matter are already in place. Atom 18 is the aromatic carbon carrying it over a non-ring bond, so I remove it. The product is N-{4-[(4-ethylpyridin-2-yl)amino]phenyl}cyclopropanecarboxamide at 281 Da - identical to my best molecule except that the pyridine 4-substituent is an ethyl rather than a methyl, so this is a clean single-variable test of whether that alkyl wants to be larger.
